scope: Numerical reporting, provenance and outcome-specific evaluation; end-to-end grain-loss predictive validity is not established
Results_focus: Predictive support, canopy damage, production exposure, annual risk, crop–disease timing and observed management responses

full_grid_domain_check.source: Bundled paired grid values and valid-year counts

production_exposure_and_timing.timing_population: Identical complete pairs for all event and interval means
production_exposure_and_timing.production_interpretation: Fixed baseline production located in exposed cells; not estimated grain loss

annual_canopy_risk.complete_population: Same cells across both 30-year periods and all three climate models
annual_canopy_risk.scope: Conditional annual canopy damage; no grain-loss or adaptation validation

observed_management_grain.scope: Observed management-associated grain outcomes; source populations are not pooled
